An entity is an Affiliate only while that relationship continues.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.2","number":"1.2","heading":"“Applicable Law” means every statute, regulation, binding regulatory requirement, court order, and governmental rule applicable to a Party's performance under this Agreement, including laws concerning privacy, information security, export controls, employment, anti-bribery, and accessibility. Applicable Law does not include a private standard unless an Order Form expressly adopts it.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.3","number":"1.3","heading":"“Customer Data” means all data, records, files, content, personal information, and other materials submitted to, stored in, transmitted through, or otherwise made available to the Services by or for Customer or its Authorized Users, together with output specifically derived from that material. Customer Data excludes anonymized operational telemetry that cannot reasonably be linked to Customer, an Authorized User, or an individual.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.4","number":"1.4","heading":"“Deliverable” means each report, configuration, integration, specification, design, workflow, training material, and other work product that an Order Form identifies as being created specifically for Customer. Deliverables exclude Vendor Technology and generally applicable ideas, methods, skills, and know-how retained in the unaided memory of Vendor personnel.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.5","number":"1.5","heading":"“Fees” means the recurring subscription fees, professional services fees, usage fees, and other amounts payable by Customer under an Order Form for the Services during the applicable period. Fees do not include taxes, reimbursable expenses, service credits, interest, damages, or a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form expressly states otherwise.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.6","number":"1.6","heading":"“Order Form” means a written ordering document signed by authorized representatives of both Parties that references this Agreement and describes the Services, Deliverables, subscription quantities, service levels, Fees, and term purchased by Customer. A purchase order is an administrative convenience only and does not amend an Order Form or this Agreement.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.7","number":"1.7","heading":"“Services” means the hosted software, implementation, configuration, support, maintenance, consulting, and related services described in an Order Form. Services include all corrections, updates, and generally released improvements Vendor provides without an additional licence fee to similarly situated customers purchasing the same service tier.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-1.8","number":"1.8","heading":"“Vendor Technology” means Vendor's pre-existing software, tools, models, templates, documentation, routines, connectors, and other technology, and modifications of them that are not Deliverables and do not embody Customer Confidential Information. Vendor Technology does not include Customer Data or intellectual property owned by Customer before the Effective Date.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-2","number":"2","heading":"AGREEMENT STRUCTURE AND SCOPE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-2.1","number":"2.1","heading":"This Agreement establishes the legal terms under which Customer and its Affiliates may purchase Services from Vendor. No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-2.2","number":"2.2","heading":"Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-2.2-2","number":"2.2","heading":"Each Order Form is governed by this Agreement. If provisions conflict, the following order controls: a signed amendment that expressly identifies the provision amended; the applicable Order Form; any service-level exhibit; any security exhibit; and this Agreement. An Order Form prevails only for that Order Form and only when it expressly identifies the conflicting provision.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-2.3","number":"2.3","heading":"Vendor terms appearing on a website, click-through screen, invoice, quotation, acknowledgement, support portal, or purchase-order response do not apply, even if access to the Services technically requires acceptance. Customer's use of or payment for Services does not assent to additional or different terms.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-3","number":"3","heading":"SERVICES AND PERFORMANCE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-3.1","number":"3.1","heading":"Vendor shall provide the Services professionally, diligently, and in accordance with this Agreement, each Order Form, the documentation, agreed project plans, and Applicable Law. Vendor is responsible for the acts and omissions of its personnel, Affiliates, and subcontractors as though they were Vendor's own.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-4","number":"4","heading":"ORDER FORMS AND AFFILIATE ORDERS","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-4.1","number":"4.1","heading":"An Order Form becomes binding when signed by both Parties. Changes in scope, assumptions, quantities, Fees, dependencies, or dates require a written change order signed by authorized representatives. Vendor shall not charge for work outside scope that Customer did not approve in a signed change order.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-5","number":"5","heading":"IMPLEMENTATION AND CHANGE CONTROL","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-5.1","number":"5.1","heading":"Vendor shall prepare and maintain an implementation plan identifying tasks, owners, assumptions, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria, risks, and target dates. The Parties will hold regular status meetings during implementation. Vendor shall keep accurate action and decision logs and furnish them to Customer on request.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-6","number":"6","heading":"ACCEPTANCE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-6.1","number":"6.1","heading":"Customer will have fifteen business days after delivery of a Deliverable to test it against the acceptance criteria in the applicable Order Form. Customer may accept it in writing or reject it by describing material nonconformities. Payment, productive use needed for testing, or silence does not constitute acceptance.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-6.2","number":"6.2","heading":"If Customer rejects a Deliverable, Vendor shall promptly correct the nonconformities at no additional charge and resubmit it for a new acceptance period. After two unsuccessful correction cycles, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form and receive a refund of Fees paid for the rejected Deliverable and dependent Services Customer cannot reasonably use.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7","number":"7","heading":"FEES, INVOICING, AND TAXES","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.1","number":"7.1","heading":"Customer shall pay the Fees stated in each Order Form. Fees are fixed during the initial term unless an Order Form expressly provides a usage-based unit price. Vendor may not impose a platform, support, administration, minimum-use, or similar charge that the Order Form does not identify.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.2","number":"7.2","heading":"Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.2-2","number":"7.2","heading":"Vendor shall invoice no more frequently than monthly in arrears, except that an Order Form may state annual subscription Fees are invoiced in advance. Each invoice must identify the Order Form, period, Services, quantities, applicable credits, and a valid purchase-order number if Customer supplied one. Proper undisputed invoices are due forty-five days after receipt.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.3","number":"7.3","heading":"Customer may withhold a genuinely disputed amount by notifying Vendor before its due date and explaining the basis. The Parties will work promptly and in good faith to resolve the dispute. Vendor shall continue the Services while a payment dispute is pending and shall not charge interest on an amount ultimately found not due.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.4","number":"7.4","heading":"Fees exclude sales, use, value-added, and similar transaction taxes that Vendor is legally required to collect and separately states on a valid invoice. Customer is not responsible for taxes on Vendor's income, property, payroll, personnel, or franchise, or for taxes avoidable through Vendor's timely use of a valid exemption certificate.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.5","number":"7.5","heading":"Pre-approved travel expenses are reimbursable at cost without markup and in accordance with Customer's travel policy. Vendor shall provide receipts and request reimbursement within sixty days. All other expenses are included in the Fees.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-7.6","number":"7.6","heading":"Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-8","number":"8","heading":"TERM AND RENEWAL","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-8.1","number":"8.1","heading":"This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for three years unless earlier terminated in accordance with its terms. Expiration of this Agreement does not itself terminate an Order Form then in effect; this Agreement continues to govern that Order Form until the Order Form expires or is terminated.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-8.2","number":"8.2","heading":"Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-8.3","number":"8.3","heading":"On renewal, Vendor may increase recurring Fees only by the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers during the preceding twelve months and three percent. Vendor must give at least ninety days' written notice of an increase. No increase applies to prepaid periods.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-9","number":"9","heading":"TERMINATION","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-9.1","number":"9.1","heading":"Either Party may terminate this Agreement or an affected Order Form for the other Party's material breach if the breach remains uncured thirty days after written notice describing it in reasonable detail. If a breach cannot reasonably be cured within thirty days, the cure period extends up to sixty additional days while the breaching Party diligently pursues cure.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-9.2","number":"9.2","heading":"Either Party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other becomes insolvent, makes a general assignment for creditors, enters liquidation, or becomes subject to a bankruptcy proceeding not dismissed within sixty days. A lawful reorganization that does not impair performance is not, by itself, grounds for termination.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-9.3","number":"9.3","heading":"Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-9.5","number":"9.5","heading":"Termination of one Order Form does not terminate another Order Form unless Customer states that the affected Services are operationally inseparable. A termination right is in addition to, and does not exclude, any other remedy available under this Agreement or Applicable Law.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-10","number":"10","heading":"EFFECT OF EXPIRY OR TERMINATION","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-10.1","number":"10.1","heading":"On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-10.2","number":"10.2","heading":"Vendor shall deliver all completed and in-process Deliverables for which Customer has paid or agrees to pay the applicable proportionate Fees. Vendor shall refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination, together with Fees paid for Services Customer cannot reasonably use because of Vendor's uncured breach.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-11","number":"11","heading":"TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA RETURN","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-11.1","number":"11.1","heading":"Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-11.2","number":"11.2","heading":"Within thirty days after Customer's request, Vendor shall return all Customer Data in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with relationships and metadata reasonably necessary for use. Vendor shall not withhold Customer Data because of a fee dispute.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-11.3","number":"11.3","heading":"After Customer confirms successful return, Vendor shall securely delete remaining Customer Data from active systems and, as backups cycle, from backups, except for a copy required by Applicable Law. An authorized officer shall certify deletion in writing. Any retained copy remains protected and may not be used for another purpose.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-12","number":"12","heading":"CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-12.3","number":"12.3","heading":"Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-12.4","number":"12.4","heading":"For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-13","number":"13","heading":"ACCESS RIGHTS AND LICENCE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-13.1","number":"13.1","heading":"Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer. Customer may permit Authorized Users to exercise those rights.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-13.2","number":"13.2","heading":"For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-13.3","number":"13.3","heading":"Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-13.4","number":"13.4","heading":"Customer shall not knowingly reverse engineer hosted source code except to the extent a restriction is prohibited by Applicable Law, interfere with the Services, bypass documented security controls, or use the Services to violate Applicable Law. These restrictions do not limit testing authorized by the security exhibit or use of Customer Data and output.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-14","number":"14","heading":"INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND DELIVERABLES","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-14.1","number":"14.1","heading":"As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-14.2","number":"14.2","heading":"Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-14.3","number":"14.3","heading":"Vendor retains Vendor Technology. To the extent Vendor Technology is incorporated in or required to use a Deliverable, the perpetual licence in Section 13.2 applies. Vendor shall identify material Vendor Technology in a Deliverable before delivery and may not incorporate third-party material that materially restricts Customer's intended use without written approval.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-14.4","number":"14.4","heading":"No jointly owned intellectual property is created unless the Parties sign a separate instrument identifying it and their exploitation rights. Feedback is voluntary; Vendor may use generalized suggestions without identifying Customer or disclosing Customer Confidential Information, and Customer retains the unrestricted right to use its own feedback.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-15","number":"15","heading":"CUSTOMER DATA AND PRIVACY","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-15.1","number":"15.1","heading":"Vendor shall process Customer Data only on Customer's documented instructions, to provide the Services, and as permitted by this Agreement. Vendor shall not sell Customer Data, use it for advertising, combine it with another customer's identifiable data, or train a generally available model on it without Customer's express written consent.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-15.2","number":"15.2","heading":"Each Party shall comply with Applicable Law concerning personal information. If Vendor processes personal information for Customer, the Parties' data-processing addendum is incorporated. Vendor is a processor or service provider and shall assist Customer with data-subject requests, impact assessments, consultations, and regulatory inquiries.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-16","number":"16","heading":"CONFIDENTIALITY","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-16.1","number":"16.1","heading":"“Confidential Information” means non-public information disclosed by or for a Party that is marked confidential or that a reasonable recipient would understand to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances. Customer Data, security information, product plans, pricing, personnel data, and the terms of this Agreement are Confidential Information whether or not marked.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-16.2","number":"16.2","heading":"The recipient shall use Confidential Information only to perform or exercise rights under this Agreement, protect it with at least reasonable care, and disclose it only to personnel, Affiliates, advisers, and subcontractors who need to know and are bound by confidentiality obligations. The recipient is responsible for their unauthorized use or disclosure.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-16.5","number":"16.5","heading":"On request or termination, the recipient shall return or destroy Confidential Information, subject to routine backups and legal retention. Duties for trade secrets continue while protected as trade secrets; duties for other Confidential Information continue for five years after disclosure. Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-17","number":"17","heading":"INFORMATION SECURITY","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-17.1","number":"17.1","heading":"Vendor shall maintain a written information-security program using administrative, technical, organizational, and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of Customer Data and risk. At minimum, Vendor shall implement least-privilege access, multifactor authentication, encryption in transit and at rest, secure development, vulnerability management, logging, backup, business continuity, and annual workforce training.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-17.2","number":"17.2","heading":"Vendor shall notify Customer without undue delay and no later than twenty-four hours after confirming unauthorized access to, acquisition, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction of Customer Data or a material compromise of systems used to provide the Services (a “Security Incident”). Notice will include known facts, affected data and systems, containment, and a contact.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-18","number":"18","heading":"INSURANCE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-18.1","number":"18.1","heading":"Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-18.2","number":"18.2","heading":"Policies will be issued by reputable insurers and be primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary. On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance and evidence of relevant coverage. Vendor shall give advance notice of cancellation or material reduction to the extent available from its insurer. Insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19","number":"19","heading":"WARRANTIES","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19.1","number":"19.1","heading":"Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form. Vendor further warrants that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19.2","number":"19.2","heading":"For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19.3","number":"19.3","heading":"Vendor warrants the Services and Deliverables will not contain malicious code intentionally introduced by Vendor, and that Vendor will comply with Applicable Law. Vendor will not materially diminish functionality during a term or use open-source software in a way that requires disclosure or licensing of Customer source code.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19.4","number":"19.4","heading":"For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-19.5","number":"19.5","heading":"Except for the express warranties in this Agreement, neither Party makes an implied warranty to the maximum extent lawful. No disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity, confidentiality duty, data-protection duty, or remedy expressly provided here.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20","number":"20","heading":"INDEMNIFICATION","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20.1","number":"20.1","heading":"Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20.2","number":"20.2","heading":"Vendor shall also defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Customer indemnified parties from third-party claims to the extent arising from Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; bodily injury, death, or tangible property damage caused by Vendor; unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or fraud.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20.3","number":"20.3","heading":"Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor from a third-party claim alleging that unmodified Customer material supplied by Customer and used by Vendor strictly as authorized infringes an intellectual property right, or arising from Customer's violation of Applicable Law in its authorized use of the Services. Customer has no obligation to the extent a claim arises from Vendor Technology, modification, combination, or instructions.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20.4","number":"20.4","heading":"The indemnified Party shall give prompt notice, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, and control of the defence, except delay excuses obligations only to the extent of material prejudice. The indemnifying Party may not settle a claim by admitting fault of, imposing non-monetary obligations on, or failing to fully release the indemnified Party without prior written consent.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-20.5","number":"20.5","heading":"For an infringement claim, Vendor shall, at its expense and in addition to its defence obligations, procure continued use, modify or replace the affected item without materially reducing functionality, or, if neither is commercially reasonable, terminate the item and refund prepaid and implementation Fees on a straight-line three-year basis. Vendor may not terminate unaffected Services.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-21","number":"21","heading":"LIMITATION OF LIABILITY","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-21.1","number":"21.1","heading":"Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-21.2","number":"21.2","heading":"Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill, to the extent those damages are legally excludable. Costs of restoring Customer Data, obtaining replacement services, required notices, and reasonable incident response are direct damages.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-21.3","number":"21.3","heading":"“Excluded Claims” means a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations; its indemnification obligations; gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or fraud; or infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property. Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-21.4","number":"21.4","heading":"The limitations allocate risk between sophisticated Parties and apply only to the maximum extent permitted by Applicable Law. Nothing limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Each cap and exclusion is independent and survives failure of an exclusive remedy.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-22","number":"22","heading":"AUDIT RIGHTS","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-22.1","number":"22.1","heading":"Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-22.2","number":"22.2","heading":"Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent for the audited period, in which case Customer will pay reasonable audit costs and the undisputed shortfall. Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-22.3","number":"22.3","heading":"Audit findings are Customer Confidential Information and may be used only to enforce this Agreement. Vendor shall provide a copy of the final report. Payment of a shortfall resolves the audited quantity issue absent fraud or demonstrable error.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-23","number":"23","heading":"RECORDS AND CUSTOMER ASSURANCE","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-24","number":"24","heading":"ASSIGNMENT AND CHANGE OF CONTROL","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-24.1","number":"24.1","heading":"Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates. Customer shall give prompt written notice, and the assignee shall assume the applicable obligations.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-24.2","number":"24.2","heading":"Vendor may not assign this Agreement, delegate material performance, or transfer it by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld for an assignee with adequate capability and financial standing. Vendor may never assign to a direct Customer competitor without Customer's consent.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-24.3","number":"24.3","heading":"For other assignments, neither Party may assign without the other's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. A permitted assignment does not relieve accrued obligations. An attempted assignment contrary to this Section is void to the extent permitted by law.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-24.4","number":"24.4","heading":"Customer's change of control does not give Vendor a right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service. Vendor shall cooperate with reasonable administrative changes needed to reflect a permitted successor.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-25","number":"25","heading":"PUBLICITY AND MARKS","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-25.1","number":"25.1","heading":"Neither Party may issue a press release naming the other or use the other's names, trademarks, logos, or service marks in publicity, customer lists, case studies, or marketing without prior written consent in each instance. Customer may withdraw consent prospectively.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-26","number":"26","heading":"COMPLIANCE WITH LAW AND ETHICS","level":1,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-26.1","number":"26.1","heading":"Each Party shall comply with Applicable Law in performing this Agreement. Vendor shall maintain policies reasonably designed to prevent bribery, corruption, forced labour, discrimination, retaliation, and conflicts of interest and shall provide annual compliance training to assigned personnel.","level":2,"paragraphCount":1},{"id":"sec-26.2","number":"26.2","heading":"Vendor represents it has not offered and will not offer anything of value to improperly influence an official or private person in connection with this Agreement. You are an independent verifier of one proposed contract finding.
Judge the proposal against the supplied playbook rule, original paragraphs, resolved definitions, deterministic checks, rendered redline, and comment.
Do not rely on hidden drafter reasoning. Fail invalid, directionally wrong, or rule-incomplete edits.
Deterministic checks are heuristics (regular expressions and a changed-character ratio), not verdicts: a failed regex may simply be a phrasing variant, and a high changed-character ratio is acceptable when the rule genuinely requires rewriting the clause (for example replacing a governing-law sentence or deleting a take-or-pay obligation). Weigh them as evidence and decide on substance: does the redline reach the playbook position with the smallest edit that does so, and is the comment accurate?
The claimed status matters: for a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is expected, and you should pass when the cited text supports compliance. Fail a deviation finding whose cited clause already meets the preferred or the fallback position on its material terms (the playbook's classification semantics) — a redline that merely upgrades an acceptable fallback to preferred wording is over-flagging. Compliant findings are retained as internal evaluation evidence, not raised as negotiation issues. For deviation or missing findings, require an actionable valid proposal.
Return a concise verdict with actionable reasons.

We represent the customer.
Our party aliases: Customer, Client, Licensee, Company, Buyer, Purchaser, Subscriber, User.
Counterparty aliases: Vendor, Supplier, Provider, Service Provider, Licensor, Contractor, Consultant, Seller, Host.
Comment prefix: [Playbook].
Tone: Concise, professional, first person plural ("we"). Explain what changed and why in one or two sentences, cite the playbook position, offer the fallback where sensible, never lecture.


How to classify a clause against a rule (this is how the reviewing team reads its own playbook):
- compliant: the clause meets the preferred position, OR it meets the fallback position on its material terms. A clause at the fallback is acceptable and is not redlined; say in the rationale that it sits at the fallback.
- deviation: the clause fails the fallback on a material term, or falls into walk-away territory. Only then propose a redline.
- missing: the rule expects a clause and no usable clause exists anywhere in the document.
- Minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording (a missing reminder mechanic, a missing price-uplift cap, 'paid' versus 'paid or payable', an accepted-but-not-preferred governing law) are noted in the rationale, not flagged as deviations.
- Do not flag a clause that benefits our party. Do not flag the same commercial term twice under two rules unless both rules are independently breached.

You are in-house counsel producing a concise Markdown issues memo from verified findings.
Include: Executive summary; a Markdown table of findings with severity, rule, status and section; Walk-away items; Next steps.
Never invent a section reference or legal conclusion. Use only supplied findings.

We represent the customer.
Our party aliases: Customer, Client, Licensee, Company, Buyer, Purchaser, Subscriber, User.
Counterparty aliases: Vendor, Supplier, Provider, Service Provider, Licensor, Contractor, Consultant, Seller, Host.
Comment prefix: [Playbook].
Tone: Concise, professional, first person plural ("we"). Explain what changed and why in one or two sentences, cite the playbook position, offer the fallback where sensible, never lecture.


How to classify a clause against a rule (this is how the reviewing team reads its own playbook):
- compliant: the clause meets the preferred position, OR it meets the fallback position on its material terms. A clause at the fallback is acceptable and is not redlined; say in the rationale that it sits at the fallback.
- deviation: the clause fails the fallback on a material term, or falls into walk-away territory. Only then propose a redline.
- missing: the rule expects a clause and no usable clause exists anywhere in the document.
- Minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording (a missing reminder mechanic, a missing price-uplift cap, 'paid' versus 'paid or payable', an accepted-but-not-preferred governing law) are noted in the rationale, not flagged as deviations.
- Do not flag a clause that benefits our party. Do not flag the same commercial term twice under two rules unless both rules are independently breached.

Section 19.3 warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no mid-term functionality degradation and no open-source contamination of Customer source code. Section 19.5 (p0080) is a mutual implied-warranty disclaimer that expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the conformance warranty and there is no \"AS IS\" walk-away exposure. Sections 6.1-6.2 add a parallel acceptance correction-and-refund path. Every material term meets or exceeds the playbook position, so the finding is compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment.","verification":"fail"},{"id":"f-insurance-4332969f","ruleId":"INSURANCE","ruleTitle":"Vendor insurance","severity":"low","status":"compliant","sectionRef":"§ 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.","rationale":"Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability USD 1M), professional E&O at USD 2M, and cyber/privacy at USD 5M — appropriate given Vendor hosts Customer Data — maintained throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds insurer quality, primacy, certificates of insurance on request, cancellation notice, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liability. No redline required.","verification":"pass"}]

{"markdown":"# Issues Memo — Master Services Agreement

**Prepared by:** In-house counsel (Customer side)  
**Subject:** Verified playbook findings on the Master Services Agreement

## Executive summary

We have completed our playbook review of the Master Services Agreement. The ri[REDACTED] core of the document is in good shape: Vendor indemnification (§ 20), IP and Customer Data ownership (§ 14), the mutual liability cap and carve-outs (§ 21), assignment and change of control (§ 24), the licence grant (§ 13), transition assistance and data return (§ 11), governing law and venue (§ 28), and Vendor insurance (§ 18) all meet our preferred positions and require no redline.

Our concerns are concentrated in the commercial-restraint and administrative provisions, several of which are internally inconsistent with the protections Vendor has already conceded in § 12.3 (no exclusivity, no MFN, no minimum-volume, no no-hire commitment). Eight items require action: full-term sole-source exclusivity (§ 2.2, also driving the minimum-commitment finding), uncapped Customer-payable liquidated damages (§ 7.6), a Customer-side MFN (§ 7.2), a one-sided 18-month no-hire (§ 12.4), unlimited unannounced audits with remote system access (§ 22.1), a 180-day non-renewal notice window (§ 8.2), and the absence of any termination-for-convenience right against a three-year committed term (§ 9).

One finding is recorded as needs review for internal purposes only: the warranty period in § 19.2 is spelled out as "ninety days" rather than "90 days," which caused an automated check to fail. On its substance the warranty package (§§ 19.1–19.5) meets or exceeds our position, and we do not propose raising it with Vendor.

## Findings

| Severity | Rule | Status | Section |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor | Compliant | § 20.1 (with §§ 20.2–20.5, 21.3) |
| Critical | IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data | Compliant | § 14.1 (with §§ 13.2, 14.2–14.4, 15.1) |
| Critical | LOL-CAP — Limitation of liability: cap, mutuality, carve-outs | Compliant | § 21.1 (with §§ 21.2–21.4, 18.2) |
| High | ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control | Compliant | § 24.1 (with §§ 24.2–24.4) |
| High | EXCLUSIVITY — Exclusivity binding Customer | **Deviation** | § 2.2 |
| High | LD — Liquidated damages payable by Customer | **Deviation** | § 7.6 |
| High | LICENSE — Licence grant scope | Compliant | § 13.1 (with §§ 13.2–13.3) |
| High | NONCOMPETE — Non-compete restrictions on Customer | Compliant | § 12.3 |
| High | NOSOLICIT — Non-solicitation binding Customer | **Deviation** | § 12.4 |
| High | T4C — Termination for convenience | **Missing** | § 9 |
| Medium | AUDIT — Audit rights against Customer | **Deviation** | § 22.1 |
| Medium | GOVLAW — Governing law and venue | Compliant | § 28.1 (with §§ 28.2–28.3) |
| Medium | MFN — Most-favoured-nation burdening Customer | **Deviation** | § 7.2 |
| Medium | MINCOMMIT — Minimum purchase / volume restrictions | **Deviation** | § 2.2 |
